headline: A 1997 executive order addressing how federal agencies act in the Lake Tahoe region on the California-Nevada border.
what_it_does: This order from President Clinton deals with federal government actions in the Lake Tahoe region. No summary was provided, so the exact details are not confirmed here. Based on the title, it appears to direct or coordinate how federal agencies work in the area. It is widely understood to focus on protecting the lake's environment.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies working in the Lake Tahoe area
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to guide or coordinate their activities in the region.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in or visit the Lake Tahoe region
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by how federal agencies manage land and resources there.
